title: Curvature Singularity
description: A genuine breakdown signaled by unbounded curvature, such as the divergence of curvature invariants at r = 0 in Schwarzschild; not every spacetime singularity is of this type.

relations.note: For positive Schwarzschild mass, r = 0 is a curvature singularity; r = 2GM/c² is not.
